book.name: Luka
book.title: Cau amsǝban a nê mala LUKA

content: Yesu tunǝ alaggana mǝdǝmbe male
Ɓè pwari mwashat Yesu naban came a kun Garang Jenasaret, ɓwapǝndǝa nggiki kàrì aɓalǝu aban ok cau mala Ɓakuli.
Mǝsǝì kpa arǝ awaru ɓari a kun mur. Amǝtalea kpashia, à ndaban lákkí andámbú malea.
Pǝlǝa Yesu eauwe aɓa waru man mwashat ka, mala Shiman. Ne wi ama ɓǝ̀ tasǝ ta waru a ɓá mùr bǝti nǝ kunmur. Pǝlǝa dum nǝ do a waru sǝ kǝ kani aɓwana gir.
Lang malǝna cau ka, pǝlǝa ne Shiman ama,

content.text: <<Soa waru ɓǝ̀ kya ban mǝlime a mùr, sǝ wu túr ndámbú ace bwal nji.>>

content: Shiman eari wi ama, <<Ɓwamǝgule, sǝm mal dù aban tanni, sǝ ko sǝm bwal kǝgìr ɗàng. Sǝ acemǝnana awu nǝ na ka, mǝ nǝ túr ndámbú.>>
Lang à túrna ndámbú ka, à bwal nji lùmsǝ ndámbú, gandǝa ndámbú tita sana.
Pǝlǝa à tunǝ aɓia mǝnana aɓa ɓe waru ka, ɓǝà yi bwalia wia. À yì lumsǝ amǝnia yì awaru ɓari ka nǝ nji, gandǝa awaru tita ko a mùr.
Lang Shiman Bitǝrus sǝn mǝnia yì gir ka, kpa a ɓadǝm Yesu sǝ na ama, <<Mǝ nda yan sǝ awu nǝ came abanam, Mǝtalabangŋo, mim ngga mǝ nda mǝ'cauɓikea.>>
Yì andǝ aɓi ka à ndali nǝ làkkì mala nji mǝnana à bwal ka.
Anggo gbal sǝ aɓi amǝtúró mala Shiman, yia Jemis andǝ Yohana, amuna mala Zabadi ndali. Yesu pǝlǝa ne Shiman ama,

content.text: <<Ɓangciu ɓǝ̀ kǝa pakko ɗang, twal ado ka, aɓwana na a nǝ nggǝ bwalia ɓǝa yiu abanam ngga, anji na ɗang.>>

content: Pǝlǝa à yì kpashi awaru a nza, sǝ à nying koya gir ka, à o atà Yesu.
Yesu twali mǝdakali bankwano male

A ɓekǝ pwari ka Yesu nda a ɓè là. Ɓè ɓwa mǝnana ndanǝ kwánó dakali ka yiu a banì. Lang sǝn Yesu ka, kara yi ɓunno a ɓadǝmbi, sǝ zǝmbi wi ama, <<Ɓwamǝgule, ɓǝ̀ a nǝ ear ka, a nǝ gandǝ twàlâm-ban dakali mǝnia a rǝàm ngga, ɓǝn ɓoarnsari.>>
Yesu lǝmdǝ buì je, ne wi ama,

content.text: <<Ən earǝna, dakali mo ka à langŋǝ́nì, ɓǝ̀ rǝo malâ.>>

content: Àkǝ̀ banì kara dakali malâ.
Yesu pǝlǝa ne wi ama,

content.text: <<Kǝa ne kǝɓwa ce ɗàng, bwal njar kyane a ban pǝris ɓǝ̀ pelǝkio; sǝ wu pa ɓoro mǝnana Musa tsǝa ama ɓǝa pà ka, ace mǝnana koyan ngga ɓǝ̀ sǝlǝ ama rǝo sonzǝna.>>

content: Kat andǝ amani ka cau amur Yesu akiban, gandǝa ɓwabundǝa yiu ace ok cau male andǝ kum twalban akwánó mǝnana a rǝia ka.
Sǝ pak ka Yesu kǝ o arǝ ban mǝnana kǝɓwa pà kàm raka ace pak hiwi.
Yesu twali ɓeɓwa ban rǝkwanamala rǝwuna

Ɓè pwari mwashat Yesu ka nda ban kanigir, amǝ Farisi andǝ amalǝm Nggurcau mala Musa mǝnana à purkio arǝ amuna-là ɗàngɗáng aɓalǝ abu-nzali Galili andǝ Yahudi, andǝ Urǝshalima ka, à ndakam aban do. Sǝ Bangŋo mala Ɓakuli ka nda te ace sonzǝ amǝ rǝkwana.
Aɓea ɓwana yiu nǝ mǝkwánó rǝwuna, à twali a kala. À ɓariki à nǝ̀ kútí nǝi a ɓala, à nǝ̀ nggá nongsǝi a ɓadǝm Yesu.
Lang à kum njar mǝnana à nǝ̀ kútí nǝi raka, ace làkkì mala ɓwabundǝa ka, à pǝlǝa à eauwe amur kurǝm, à mǝn ban, sǝ à sùlǝì andǝ kala male a ɓadǝm Yesu aɓalǝ aɓwana.
Lang Yesu sǝn gūliarǝu malea ka, pǝlǝa ne mǝkwánó ama,
Amalǝm Nggurcau andǝ amǝ Farisi tita ndali nǝ ɓabumia ama, <<Yana mǝnia yì ɓwa kǝ ak bancame mala Ɓakuli ka! Ɓǝ̀ Ɓakuli nǝmurǝì raka, yana nǝ̀ twalban cauɓikea!>>
Yesu súrǝ̀ ɗenyicau malea pǝlǝa ɗia ma,

content.text: <<Ace mana sǝ wu kǝ ɗikiban a ɓabum wun amur man yì cau ka?
Mǝ ye nda kwano kútì ɓì, ɓǝà na ama, <À twalǝno ban acauɓikea mò le> ko ɓǝà na ama, <Lo, wu gya?>
Sǝ ace mǝnana ɓǝ̀ wu sǝlǝ ama Muna mala Ɓwa ka ndanǝ rǝcandǝa amur ɓanza nǝ̀ twalban cauɓikea ka, mǝ nǝ lǝmdǝa wun.>>

content: Pǝlǝa ne mǝkwánó rǝwuna ama,

content.text: <<Lo, twal kala mò o a ɓala!>>

content: Anggo ka kara lo cam nǝ came a ɓadǝmbia, twal kala mǝnana nongŋo amurí ka, o a ɓala, kǝ ɓwangsǝki Ɓakuli.
Koyan ngga ndali, sǝ à kǝ ɓwangsǝki Ɓakuli. Muria kàrria kǝ̀rkǝ́r, à na ama, <<Sǝm sǝnǝna agir gyamiban yalung.>>
Yesu tunǝ Lawi
Anzǝm man ngga Yesu puro pǝlǝa sǝn mǝ'ak boalo-cemi, lùllǝì ama Lawi, dumǝna aɓa mǝdanki cemi. Yesu ne wi ama,
Lawi par buì lo, nying girbunda kat o atè.
Pǝlǝa Lawi tunǝ pakkiɗire mǝgule mala li girlina ace Yesu a ɓala male. Sǝ pas aɓalǝ aɓwabundǝa mǝnana aban li ateà ka amǝ'ak boalo-cemi na.

Sǝ aɓea amǝ Farisi andǝ amalǝm Nggurcau malea nggwani aban alaggana mala Yesu ama, <<Palang sǝ wu kǝ lili, wu kǝ nuki agir wunǝ amǝ'ak boalo-cemi andǝ amǝ'cauɓikea, aɓwana mǝnana à kǝ kpata Nggurcau mala Musa raka.>>
Yesu earia wia ama,

content.text: <<Aɓwana mǝnana rǝia bang ngga à alkiyita mǝsonzǝo ɗang, amǝ rǝkwana na à alkiyita mǝsonzǝo ka.
Ən yiu ace tunǝ amǝ'cauɓoarna ɗang, ǝn yiu ace amǝ'cauɓikea ɓǝa nyare aban Ɓakuli.>>

content: Amǝ Farisi andǝamalǝm Nggurcauɗì Yesu amur gilmùr
Aɓea ɓwana ne Yesu ama, <<Alaggana mala Yohana ka à kǝ gilmùr, sǝ à kǝ pak hiwi tùtù. Anggo gbal sǝ alaggana mala amǝ Farisi kǝ pa. Sǝ amo yì alaggana ka à came arǝ li sǝ à kǝ nu.>>
Yesu earia wia ama,

content.text: <<Wu nǝ̀ tsǝk agyajam mala bura-māfela ɓǝa gilmùr yi mǝnana nda tea più ka le?
Pwari na kǝ yiu ka, mǝnana à nǝ̀ twal bura-māfela a rǝia ka. Amǝno yì pwari ka sǝ à nǝ̀ gilmùr.>>

content: Pǝlǝa nea wia mǝnia yì kanicau ka, ama:

content.text: Kǝɓwa pà nǝ̀ san kun nggubyau mǝbǝshe, sǝ nǝ̀ mbàkìnà mǝ'e nǝi ɗàng. Ɓǝ̀ pè anggo ka, sanǝna nggubyau mǝbǝshe, sǝ mbàkì mana sannì arǝ nggubyau mǝbǝshe ka pà nǝ̀ ak rǝarǝia andǝ mǝ'e ɗang.
Sǝ kǝɓwa pà nǝ̀ so mur anap mǝbǝshe aɓa du mǝ'e nǝ̀ funyi kúni ɗang. Ɓǝ̀ pè anggo ka mùr-anap mǝbǝshe mǝno ka nǝ̀ ar du, nǝ̀ sukkio, sǝ du ka nǝ̀ ueɓà.
Mùr-anap mǝbǝshe ka aɓa du mǝbǝshe sǝ à nǝ̀ soé.
Sǝ kǝɓwa pà nǝ̀ nu mur anap mǝ'e, sǝ nǝ̀ earce mǝbǝshe ɗang. Acemǝnana nǝ̀ na ama, <<Mǝ'e ɓoaro kútì mǝbǝshe.>>
